items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...James T. Maher, who was based – he was a good friend of mine. [INTERVIEWEE] He published?

ctx.x: Killer, killer book. On the piano. I tell you, there are times I really read it. That’s the – I tell everybody, you want to know what the standard is? That’s the standard.
Which, by the way, that book would not have been written if it hadn’t been for James T. Maher, who was based – he was a good friend of mine.
